project.name: docx4j-docx-anon (relocated to docx4j-core)
project.description: The anonymiser (org.docx4j.anon) moved into docx4j-core in 17.2.1, once its one dependency (com.thedeanda:lorem) was replaced by docx4j's own word list. This POM is the relocation: a build that still depends on docx4j-docx-anon is told to depend on docx4j-core instead. The package name is unchanged. To be removed at the next minor release.

relocation.message: org.docx4j.anon is in docx4j-core since 17.2.1; depend on docx4j-core.
